from google.cloud import translate


def translate_text(text, target_language='en'):
    client = translate.TranslationServiceClient()
    parent = f'projects/{client.project}/locations/global'
    response = client.translate_text(request={
        'parent': parent,
        'contents': [text],
        'mime_type': 'text/plain',
        'target_language_code': target_language})
    return response.translations[0].translated_text

from google.cloud import vision


def check_safety(text):
    client = vision.ImageAnnotatorClient()
    image = vision.Image()
    image.content = text.encode('utf-8')
    response = client.safe_search_detection(image=image)
    return response.safe_search_annotation

from google.cloud import documentai


def extract_fields(text):
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
    name = client.processor_path('project-id', 'location', 'processor-id')
    response = client.process_document(request={"name": name, "raw_document": documentai.RawDocument(
        content=text.encode('utf-8'), mime_type='text/plain')}
    return response.document.entities

from google.cloud import language


def embed_text(text):
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.Document(content=text, type_=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    response = client.analyze_sentiment(request={"document": document})
    return response.document_sentiment.score
